text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Elevated 5xx rate observed for cross-region requests (eu-west2 -> us-east1). Auto-detect: TLS handshake failures on route-proxy fleet. Paging @network oncall.

sasha: i’m on it, taking triage. seeing spike at 2026-03-17T20:10Z. frontends return 503/524 from eu-west2 -> us-east1 proxies.

pranav: i pushed cert rotation to route-proxy canary at 20:05Z, rollout started at 20:09Z. canary looked fine. did the global rollout start? cc @sasha

sasha: rollout shows successful apply in all regions except eu-west2 — API server returned 202 then stalled. logs show repeated `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` from route-proxy when dialing upstream.

irene: support dashboard: ~3% of EU customer requests failing with 5xx. some customers reporting transient auth failures. i've opened a customer-impact note.

dmitri: i'm next oncall for network, paging in. what's the immediate mitigation plan? can we revert cert change or pin to previous secret?

pranav: can attempt hot-rollback — we have stable secret `route-proxy-tls-v1` in `secrets/stable`. deploy step: `kubectl -n infra set secret tls route-proxy-tls --from-file=...` but need to coordinate with control-plane push to eu-west2.

sasha: logs (eu-west2 route-proxy):
```
2026-03-17T20:11:02Z route-proxy[main] ERROR tls: handshake error: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
2026-03-17T20:11:03Z route-proxy[main] WARN upstream connect failed: dial tcp 10.40.5.12:8443: tls: handshake error
```

network-eng: looked into cert chain — intermediate CA in the rotated bundle missing for eu-west2 only. appears the orchestration job truncated file during S3 fetch (403 -> empty object) caused incomplete secret.

sasha: ok mitigation — roll back to stable secret in eu-west2 first, then re-run global rotation with validated bundle. prio: restore customer traffic.

pranav: initiating rollback now. applying secret from `s3://redwood-secrets/stable/route-proxy-tls-v1.tar.gz` to eu-west2 control plane. command: `kubectl --context=eu-west2 -n infra apply -f /tmp/route-proxy-tls.yaml`

incident-bot: Pager escalation: acknowledged by sasha, pranav. dmitri is joining the call. Incident priority: P1 -> live mitigation in progress.

sasha: applied secret at 20:33Z. restarting route-proxy pods in eu-west2: `kubectl --context=eu-west2 -n infra rollout restart deploy/route-proxy` — rolling pods 3/3.

irene: monitoring: 5xx rate dropping. customer error rate from 3% -> 0.5% since 20:35Z. notifying SRE and CS.

support-bot: Customer notification sent to affected accounts list. internal note created: INC-2026-032.

dmitri: thanks team — looks like rollback succeeded. metrics show recovery at 20:36Z. we should block further global rotations until postmortem.

pranav: agreed — pausing automated cert-rotation pipeline. opening rollback PR and blocking pipeline with flag `rotation.paused=true`.

sasha: quick runbook updates: add S3 fetch verification + size/hash check before rollout and add canary cross-region e2e (tls handshake test) to pipeline.

network-eng: assigned postmortem to @network-eng, will include timeline, root cause (truncated bundle in eu-west2 fetch), mitigations, and follow-ups (pipeline hardening, alert rule to detect cert chain incompleteness).

irene: impact summary for customers: window 20:10Z-20:36Z, peak error rate ~3%, affected eu->us cross-region requests. follow-up comms in progress.

sasha: incident resolved for now, keeping thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
